title: Tech Note: ACME Client Component for 4D - Part I
author: Timothy Aaron Penner, Senior Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: 4D subsequently added native, built-in Let's Encrypt/ACME certificate support directly in 4D Server's web settings, making this custom open-source component (still referenced/available on GitHub) largely redundant for straightforward use cases, though it remains a valid educational example of implementing ACME from scratch in 4D.
